title: McDonald's (MCD), What Is Behind The Fresh Attention Now?
summary: McDonald's (MCD) just lifted its quarterly cash dividend to US$1.93 per share, a 4% rise that takes the annual payout to US$7.72. The move lands while the stock trades well below its 1 year high. The richer payout comes at a tougher time for the share price. title: How Low Can Dutch Bros Stock Go?
summary: Dutch Bros (BROS) stock lost 47% over the past three months, while the S&P 500 gained 5.6% (as of September 25, 2026). The shares still cost 55.2 times the coffee chain's yearly profit, against 22.1 times for the S&P 500. The question now is how much lower Dutch Bros stock could go if the whole market falls too.
